title: DWG R2000+ packed HEADER flags mapping and no-loss control
scope: The R2000+ 32-bit HEADER flags word maps its eight documented fields to typed DRW_Header variables, survives DWG rewrite, and prevents DXF projection when undefined or reserved source bits would be lost.

authorities.name: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
LibreDWG independent implementation
authorities.detail: Its lweights table maps five-bit values 0..23 to DXF lineweights, 29..31 to BYLAYER/BYBLOCK/BYLWDEFAULT (-1/-2/-3), and marks 24..28 reserved.

authorities.name: LibreDWG header flag projection
authorities.detail: Its header setter identifies the same masks and inverse LWDISPLAY/XEDIT fields. The local implementation shifts the two two-bit groups into DXF values 0..3.

implementation.parser: src/drw_header.cpp decodes the packed word into CELWEIGHT, ENDCAPS, JOINSTYLE, LWDISPLAY, XEDIT, EXTNAMES, PSTYLEMODE, and OLESTARTUP with their DXF group codes.
implementation.dwg_writer: The writer maps modeled values back into the documented bit positions and preserves all raw bits outside mask 0x6FFF. A bit-preserving copy passes the full 32-bit pattern to the BL encoder.
implementation.dxf_writer: DXF export rejects undefined high bits and reserved CELWEIGHT codes 24..28. The three additional Boolean fields are range-checked before output.
implementation.state: The retained word participates in DRW_Header copy, move, swap, parse reset, and destruction/reset paths.

validation.result: Passed. The generated packed-flags control checks exact field mapping, inverse booleans, all six writer versions AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032, undefined high-bit DWG readback, reserved-lineweight refusal/preservation, invalid-value refusal, corrected retry, and ASCII/Binary DXF refusal-before-output followed by same-writer retry after raw-flag repair.
validation.fixture_policy: No external DWG/DXF fixture was added. All vector and writer/readback inputs are generated locally from scratch.

limitations: No authentic producer DWG was used as a packed-flags witness.
The source parser maps reserved CELWEIGHT indexes 24..28 to the tolerant zero value while retaining their raw code; DXF projection refuses this ambiguous state.
Undefined bits are retained for DWG rewrite but are not assigned semantics.
The broader P6 version, geometry, object graph, native consumer, and platform exit requirements remain open.
